title: Experiment run receipt
description: Schema only. No example values are provided on purpose: every value in a real receipt must come from the run itself (see scripts/make_receipt.py). Receipts are write-once; a rerun produces a new receipt.

experiment_id.description: Stable id linking the receipt to its pre-registration / plan.

status.description: COMPLETED means the run finished and produced results; it does not mean the results are correct. Provenance labels in the write-up carry that judgment.

failure_reason.description: Required when status is FAILED or PARTIAL (OOM, divergence, crash, timeout, ...).

plan_ref.description: Path or id of the pre-registration this run belongs to.

command.description: Exact command line (or notebook cell / entry point) that produced the run.

notes.description: Free text, e.g. 'smoke test on tiny config' or deviations from plan.

dirty.description: True if uncommitted changes existed. A dirty tree weakens reproducibility.

seeds.description: All RNG seeds used. Empty only if the run has no randomness (say so in notes).

configs.description: path -> sha256 of each config file (null if missing).

data.description: path -> sha256 of each dataset/checkpoint file (null if missing).

results.description: Embedded verbatim from the metrics file the experiment itself wrote. Recommended shape per metric: { value, n, std or ci95, n_seeds, unit }. Metrics without n are flagged by make_receipt.py.

receipt_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of this receipt excluding this field. Makes edits detectable (tamper-evident, not tamper-proof).
